SELECT -SUM(t.amount) AS net_fee_revenue
FROM fct_transactions t
JOIN dim_date d ON t.transaction_date = d.date_key
WHERE t.transaction_type = 'fee'
  AND t.fee_waived = FALSE
  AND d.year = 2026
  AND d.quarter = 1

SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS total_gross_fee_revenue
FROM fct_transactions
WHERE transaction_type = 'FEE'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date) = 2025;

SELECT -SUM(t.amount) AS gross_fee_revenue
FROM fct_transactions t
WHERE t.transaction_type = 'fee'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.transaction_date) = 2025

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN days_past_due >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS delinquency_rate_30plus
FROM fct_loans_monthly
WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-03-01';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due >= 30) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS delinquency_rate_30d
FROM fct_loans_monthly
WHERE month_start = '2026-03-01'
